title: adenodolichos punctatus subsp. bussei
intro: Adenodolichos punctatus subsp. bussei, commonly known as Bussei's dolichos, is a plant species of the legume family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and fever. The health benefits of Bussei's dolichos include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Bussei's dolichos include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
